title: Bram and the Well
author: Bram Nystrom
blurb: Petra Ravensworth, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, has spent seven years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
